messages:
eval-bot: nightly-evals: pset31 (promptpack v4) FAILED on rdx-3b-quant across nightly.
failure_rate: 12% (baseline 1.2%). top error archetype: 'unexpected extra token' in instruction slot. logs: https://internal/evals/2176543211 :rotating_light:

carla: ugh saw this alert. v4 rebaseline merged ~8h ago by @sam, right after CI green. :eyes:

sam: yep that was the rebaseline PR. quick check: CI pass was on CPU eval harness, not quantized runtime. did not run dedicated quant smoke.

mohit: can confirm reproduces locally on rdx-3b-quant with the nightly harness. looks like model outputs shifted on several cases where prompt had trailing whitespace in examples.

julia: trailing whitespace? that's a weird regression vector. any diffs in the promptpack changes that would do that?

sam: I diffed prompt examples; v3 had some examples with a trailing space after the colon. v4 cleaned them up. example:
```
- Q: Name: Alice 
+ Q: Name: Alice
```
That removes a space before newline. Tokenizer tokenized those differently in quantized runtime for that model config.

qa: confirmed tokenization delta between the two forms — tokenizer adds an extra space-token in our token IDs which changes prefix kv-cache alignment. on long prompts that flips downstream generation in ~8% of cases.

carla: so the rebaseline inadvertently changed canonical prompt text and that cascaded into a quality delta. two options: revert the rebaseline to keep v3 canonical whitespace, or add a normalization step in the eval harness (and in production prompt normalization). thoughts?

mohit: quantized kernels amplify minor token shifts because attention window packing differs when token count changes. reverting is fastest to fix nightly numbers; long-term we should normalise prompts before send and update promptbank canonicalization rules.

sam: I can open a PR to revert the whitespace cleanup on the few affected examples — small patch. also will add a smoke job that runs quantized canary for rebaselines.

julia: agree add smoke + add normalization. normalization must be opt-in for existing customers (we can't rewrite user prompts), but for our eval harness and promptbank we should canonicalize the stored prompts.

qa: action items:
- sam: PR revert promptpack v4 whitespace changes (target: roll forward to nightly by next run)
- sam: add quantized smoke matrix to rebaseline CI
- mohit: write short note on why whitespace tokenization affects rdx-3b-quant (for eng-ml postmortem)
- julia: add promptbank normalization proposal (small RFC)

sam: assigning self to PR. will tag @carla for quick approval. PR link after I open it.

carla: thanks. once PR is merged we'll re-run nightly evals and watch ps31 failure_rate. if it doesn't drop to baseline we'll dig deeper. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: noted. follow-up: nightly job scheduled in ~40m, will pick up new promptpack if merged before then.

mohit: quick local run after reverting whitespace patched failures from 12% -> 1.6% on quantized harness, so looks promising.

julia: cool. also let's add a small unit in tokenization tests for promptbank CI to avoid accidental whitespace normalization in future rebaselines.

qa: adding ticket to tracker: ML-1129 "promptpack canonicalization: whitespace-induced tokenization regressions" and linking this thread.

sam: opened PR https://internal/g/PR/4123 and added canary CI entry. PTAL @carla @qa

carla: reviewing now, will approve if tests are sane.

qa: leaving for now, will monitor next nightly and mark as resolved if metrics return to baseline.
